blocks.name: brands
blocks.label: Brand names
blocks.help: One brand per line. Source brands are listed with a # source note; leave them as they are. Add a missing brand with a citation. To mark a source brand as wrong, strike it through and cite why.
blocks.example:
Glucophage   # source: Drugs@FDA, RxNorm
Riomet ER [@dailymed:…]
~~Wrongname~~ [@url:https://…] not a metformin product

forms.meaning: A brand that is already in the sources (shown with # source). No citation needed.
Add a brand the sources lack. Citation required.
Mark a source brand as wrong. It stays listed, struck through, with the reason. Citation required.

blocks.name: infobox
blocks.label: Quick Facts
blocks.help: One fact per line as key: value. Leave a value blank to use the source (shown as a # comment). A value you type replaces the source on this page and needs a citation. To record that the source is wrong and there is no value, write [NONE] with a citation.
blocks.example:
acb_score:            # source: 1 (Anticholinergic burden list)
do_not_crush: Extended-release tablets [@dailymed:…]
qtc_risk: [NONE] [@pmid:…]

blocks.name: renal-dosing
blocks.label: Renal dosing
blocks.help: One kidney-function range per line, then a colon and what to do. Use eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m²), CrCl (mL/min) or dialysis. Ranges for the same measure must not overlap. Every line needs a citation.
blocks.example:
egfr < 30: contraindicated [@dailymed:…]
egfr 30-45: do not start; if already taking, assess benefit and risk [@dailymed:…]
crcl >= 60: no adjustment [@pmid:…]
dialysis: avoid [@pmid:…]
